title: The Internet Never Forgets
tagline: Before the first packet is sent, the picture is already forming.
description: Discover what reconnaissance really means and why it is the most important phase of any attack — or any defence. Learn the difference between passive and active recon, understand OSINT, map an organisation's digital footprint, and see how attackers build a complete target picture without touching a single system.
author: Cyber Learn Team
learningObjectives: Define reconnaissance and explain its role as Phase 1 of the VAPT lifecycle
Distinguish between passive and active reconnaissance with examples of each
Explain what OSINT is and name at least five public sources used in professional recon
Describe what a digital footprint is and what it reveals about an organisation
Define attack surface and explain why it extends beyond an organisation's own systems
skills: Identifying which recon technique to apply given a specific intelligence goal
Recognising when passive recon crosses into active recon
Mapping an organisation's attack surface from public information alone
